## Aliases

- `A` = `aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa`: home #12, original head.
- `B` = `bbbb…b`: #13, original head.
- `C` = `cccc…c`: #14, original head.
- `R` = `2222222222222222222222222222222222222222`: Rework base.
- `E` = `eeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeee`: final HEAD.
- `W` = `/work/widget/.worktrees/retry`.

## Preparation order

1. Derive the paths:
   - `WORKTREE=W`
   - `PRIMARY=/work/widget`
   - `FEATURE=retry`
2. Read the spec `doc/specs/rework.md` and its Rework record, home first.
   - Home is #12, with `PRE_REWORK_HEAD=A`.
   - The record is in rebase mode, because `Rework base:` is present.
3. Confirm home: `gh pr view 12 -R acme/widget --json number,url,headRefName,baseRefName,state`.
   - Result: state `OPEN`, head `retry`, base `main`.
4. Steps 1, 2, 3 and 3.5 passed. The scoped set is `test-retry`; the task and thread evidence was captured before the strip.
5. Run the Step 4 preflight.
6. Choose row 1, then refetch threads for each of #12, #13 and #14 with the paginated `$n` query from pr-head.
7. Run strip-and-seal: `node <bin>/gauntlet-telemetry-seal.mjs --worktree W --option pr --base origin/main --spec doc/specs/rework.md`. The seal measures the whole PR, never against `A`.
8. Probe the pre-rework refs:
   - `git -C W rev-parse -q --verify refs/gauntlet/pre-rework/pr-12`, then the same for `pr-13` and `pr-14`.
   - All three exist, so they are preserved and no `update-ref` runs.
9. Push home, then fetch and edit its body.

## Preflight proof (rebase mode)

```bash
git -C W fetch origin
git -C W merge-base --is-ancestor R HEAD      # exit 0
git -C W rev-parse origin/retry               # = A
```

`origin/retry` equals `PRE_REWORK_HEAD`, so this is a lease push and row 1 is offered.

## Push

```bash
git -C W push --no-follow-tags --force-with-lease=retry:A origin HEAD:refs/heads/retry
```

The push succeeds. The pushed home head is `E`.

## Body FETCH and EDIT

```bash
JSON=$(mktemp); BODY=$(mktemp)          # scratch files, outside the repo
gh pr view 12 -R acme/widget --json body > "$JSON"
jq -j '.body' < "$JSON" > "$BODY"       # raw bytes, nothing trimmed, no command substitution
printf '\n' >> "$BODY"                  # one blank line after the existing trailing \n
cat >> "$BODY" <<'EOF'
<Rework block below>
EOF
gh pr edit 12 -R acme/widget --body-file "$BODY"
```

The resulting body bytes are `Original description\n` + `\n` + the block.

## Rework block

```markdown
## Rework

Before: aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa (local ref `refs/gauntlet/pre-rework/pr-12` in the rework checkout)
Absorbs: #13 (https://github.com/acme/widget/pull/13), #14 (https://github.com/acme/widget/pull/14)
Spec: doc/specs/rework.md at eeeeeee
Keeps: retry API
Changes: repair retry
Dropped claims: none
Verification: scoped - test-retry; CI on this push holds the full run. Telemetry: whole PR against main.
Threads:
#12:
- HOME - still open
#13:
- MEMBER13 - fix (recorded: retain delay; fixed in #13's own history)
- NEW13 - still open
#14:
- MEMBER14 - still open
```

Notes on the block:
- No `supersedes the description above` line is added, because no claims were dropped.
- Home's URL (https://github.com/acme/widget/pull/12) appears only in member close comments, which come after this checkpoint.
- Member thread dispositions are copied from the record and refresh. Home's first-parent history is not used as proof of member fixes.
- NEW13 is marked as newly opened from the refresh.

The `gh pr edit` succeeded, so this checkpoint is complete. The worktree is preserved. Member eligibility and the closure question are not rendered here, as the case requests.

### Shared preparation — prescribed, not executed

SHA aliases:
```bash
A=aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa
B=bbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbb
C=cccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccc
R=2222222222222222222222222222222222222222
H=eeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeee
WORKTREE=/work/widget/.worktrees/retry
FEATURE=retry
```

1. Retain `test-retry`, accepted-complete task evidence, and the Rework record before stripping.
2. Run rebase-mode preflight:
```bash
git -C "$WORKTREE" fetch origin
git -C "$WORKTREE" merge-base --is-ancestor "$R" HEAD
git -C "$WORKTREE" rev-parse origin/retry
```
Fetch succeeds; ancestry exits 0; origin resolves to `$A`, selecting the lease push. No original-head ancestry proof applies to this rebased history. No additional origin-descendancy proofs are needed in the exact-original-head case. Unexpected command exits stop the flow.

3. Refresh every recorded PR’s threads using the prescribed paginated query and complete comment pagination. Retain HOME as open, MEMBER13’s recorded `fix — retain delay`, MEMBER14 as open, and NEW13 as newly open. Do not infer member completion from home history.
4. Read the artifact’s `**Spec:**`, remove tracked paired task-plan/ledger candidates using the strip procedure, preserving the spec and telemetry. Seal:
```bash
node <bin>/gauntlet-telemetry-seal.mjs \
  --worktree "$WORKTREE" --option pr \
  --base origin/main --spec doc/specs/rework.md
```
Stop on seal failure; retain stdout verbatim for eventual completion.
5. Probe, preserving all existing original refs:
```bash
git -C "$WORKTREE" rev-parse -q --verify refs/gauntlet/pre-rework/pr-12
git -C "$WORKTREE" rev-parse -q --verify refs/gauntlet/pre-rework/pr-13
git -C "$WORKTREE" rev-parse -q --verify refs/gauntlet/pre-rework/pr-14
```
6. Push only home:
```bash
git -C "$WORKTREE" push --no-follow-tags \
  --force-with-lease=retry:aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa \
  origin HEAD:refs/heads/retry
git -C "$WORKTREE" rev-parse HEAD
```
Push succeeds; save `$H` as the pushed home head.

### Fresh description and exact append

Create scratch files outside the repository:
```bash
BODY_JSON=$(mktemp /tmp/widget-body-json.XXXXXX)
BODY_FILE=$(mktemp /tmp/widget-body.XXXXXX)
gh pr view 12 -R acme/widget --json body > "$BODY_JSON"
```

Decode JSON without trimming or command-substituting its body. Write its UTF-8 bytes unchanged (`Original description\n`), then one newline to form the blank separator, then this complete block:

```markdown
## Rework

Before: aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa (local ref `refs/gauntlet/pre-rework/pr-12` in the rework checkout)
Absorbs: #13 (https://github.com/acme/widget/pull/13), #14 (https://github.com/acme/widget/pull/14)
Spec: doc/specs/rework.md at eeeeeee
Keeps: retry API
Changes: repair retry
Dropped claims: none
Verification: scoped - test-retry; CI on this push holds the full run. Telemetry: whole PR against main.
Threads:
#12:
- HOME - still open
#13:
- MEMBER13 - fix - retain delay (recorded member disposition)
- NEW13 - still open
#14:
- MEMBER14 - still open
```

For example, with that block saved as `block` in the writer:
```python
body = json.load(open(json_path, encoding="utf-8"))["body"]
with open(body_path, "wb") as f:
    f.write(body.encode("utf-8"))
    f.write(b"\n")
    f.write(block.encode("utf-8"))
```

Edit the existing PR:
```bash
gh pr edit 12 -R acme/widget --body-file "$BODY_FILE"
```

Body edit succeeds. Stop at this checkpoint; ship is not yet marked complete.
